title: Documents
subtitle: Upload or paste a fee notice (English or Chinese). Setu treats it as untrusted data: it is scanned, parsed, and you confirm every field before anything is used.
pastePlaceholder: Paste the text of a fee notice here…
dropTitle: Drop a .txt notice here, or press to browse
dropHint: Plain text (.txt) only, max 2 MB · or press to browse. PDFs are not supported in this build.
sampleHint: All samples are SYNTHETIC. The injected ones are attack tests.
untrustedNote: Document text is untrusted data. It is displayed as plain text and never executed as instructions.
blockedBody: This document contains instructions aimed at the assistant. It cannot be used to move money.
confirmHelp: Compare with the original notice. Your confirmed values are what the agent will use.
accountHint: Parsed: {masked}. Re-enter the full number only if you want to override it. It is stored encrypted and masked here.
checked: I checked these values against the original notice.
blockedConfirm: Blocked — the guardian rejected this document and the event was written to the audit log (entry #{seq}).
mismatchHelp: The amount must equal the amount found in the document.
emptyText: Paste some text or choose a file first.
dropBig: Drop a fee notice, SMS or invoice
dropSub: Setu reads it, but never takes orders from it.

scan.title: Check for hidden instructions
scan.body: The guardian scans for prompt injection, payee changes and scam patterns.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: You confirm every field before anything is used.
